'''Shizuka Itō''' (Japanese: '''伊藤静''' ''Itō Shizuka'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}. She was born on December 5, 1980 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}.

In 2012, on her 32nd birthday, she announced that she had married. She is also a famous singer in her other career.
